deviations.what: The controller-loaded Dialog fragment is declared in the view's mvc:dependents aggregation and opened 1:1 via follow_up_action( cs_event-control_by_id, settingsDialog open ), the equivalent of the controller's _getDialog().then(oDialog => oDialog.open()).

The ViewSettingsDialog carries a bound filterSearchOperator attribute the original does not have. The original calls setFilterSearchOperator( mLibrary.StringFilterOperator.Contains / AnyWordStartsWith ) imperatively right before opening; it is an ordinary bindable property, so the port binds it and the two buttons just write the ABAP field.

The third button, 'Search Case Sensitive Contains', loses its case sensitivity. The original installs a live JS function through setFilterSearchCallback( caseSensitiveStringContains ) - a callback the frontend evaluates per keystroke, which no backend payload can carry and which the framework deliberately has no route for (a runtime-compiled JS string was rejected for security). The port falls back to the closest built-in operator, the case-INSENSITIVE Contains, so the button still filters but matches regardless of case. The other two buttons are unaffected.
